roadmap: 10 ④ flexible sub-assemblies (RS7.4: flexible occurrences retain their own joint state; owner order 'Go to row 10')
tier: full (document field + fold semantics + public API: two audit rounds with mutation, actual run)
before: every occurrence of a sub-assembly was folded rigid at its saved pose (flattenAssembly drops its mates); two occurrences could not differ

change.data: PartInstance.joints: this occurrence's values for its sub-assembly's internal joints, radians/mm, offsets from the saved pose; absent or all zero = the very saved document (byte-identical for every existing file)
change.fold: assembly/flexible.ts bodyDocOf builds the sub-assembly's joint tree (robot jointTreeOf) and forwardKinematics and moves its nested placements; engine/doc.ts placedBase folds it, so the viewport, placed lane, drawings, STEP/3MF, clearance, explode and the parent's face tables (mates to sub1/lid) all see the pose; occurrence-path names do not change with pose
change.api: setInstanceJoints (degrees/mm), instanceJointsOf (type, limits, value, problem); facade Assembly.setPartJoints/partJoints; chat place_part `joints` (the per-turn tool budget had no room for a new tool) and get_assembly joints/joint_problem
change.studio: Instance panel 'JOINTS (THIS OCCURRENCE)': a value per joint (° or mm, limits), Apply on Enter as one undo step, Reset
change.guards: immediate sub-assembly only; unknown key, value past a limit, non-finite value, a tree with problems → the occurrence folds rigid and the problem is reported; Open refuses malformed joints; a pattern occurrence's joints refused (PATTERN_DRIVEN), patterns copy the seed's

audits.round1: CHANGES_REQUIRED: pose maths correct (tilted two-joint chain, prismatic, offsets, rotated occurrence, within 3e-13); M1 joints on a pattern occurrence silently lost; M2 Open accepted non-finite / string joints and posed with them; L1 cached problem named the wrong occurrence; L2 stale zero key unreported; L3 comment — all fixed with tests
audits.round2: ACCEPT: fixes confirmed, 623 JSON fixtures open, 4/4 mutants killed

actualRun.run02: final source PASS: Hinge 2's Joint base~lid = 90, Enter → stored π/2 on Hinge 2 only; the posed lid is the saved lid turned 90° about Z through (20, 20) (oracle, independent rotation), Hinge 1's lid unmoved; Undo/Redo; Save and fresh Open keep it; Reset back to the saved pose; 0 page/console errors; root reviewed the screenshot (Hinge 2's lid turned off the plate, Hinge 1's along it)

followUps: robot view and chat get_assembly world_bounds leave out a sub-assembly's nested parts at any pose (pre-existing)
joints of deeper sub-assembly levels are refused (immediate level only)
gear couplings inside a sub-assembly are not built into the pose tree
a joint value {k: 0} whose limits exclude 0 now reports 'outside its limits' and stays rigid (the saved pose is outside its own limits)
